name: smart-market
description: SMART MARKET — yopiq bozor savdo joylari, to'lovlar va kamera nazorati platformasi

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
